title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-fix
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Dedicated fleet autoscaler and utilization reporting occasionally under-reported burst usage during short high-throughput windows which led to delayed scale-ups and customer impact. Root cause: race between tokenbucket accounting and the periodic utilization aggregator plus an edge-case where transient priority routing caused double-decrementing of available burst tokens. This PR: fixes burst window aggregation and stabilizes token accounting so utilization reports match actual capacity consumption during bursts; makes autoscaler treat transient priority bursts as credit-only (no permanent deduction) to avoid starvation; emits additional metrics and traces for burst accounting; adds integration tests and a dashboard to make regressions visible. Includes a small docs note about operational impact and how to interpret the new metrics. Related work: ENG-3245 for throughput guarantees tuning and SUP-456 for the customer incident that triggered this fix.
commits: fix(metrics): correct burst window aggregation and boundary timestamps
fix(autoscaler): avoid double-decrement of tokenbucket on priority fallback
perf(autoscaler): only persist sustained token deductions (>10s)
test(integration): add burst-accounting end-to-end test simulating priority routing
docs: update dedicated/operational-metrics.md with new burst metrics
